No uv pull request is linked to issue #14561
uv settings reference has no [tool.uv.hooks] table or any hook/script setting for lock, sync, build or version (first 100k of 132k chars read)
uv has existing cache-keys, dependency-metadata, extra-build-dependencies and config-settings settings, which are the closest existing build-related mechanisms
Licence is Apache-2.0 (GitHub API spdx, not re-fetched from LICENSE)
uv tests use cargo nextest (recommended) with insta snapshot tests
uv test suite requires multiple specific Python interpreters installed beforehand, and some tests need git and git-lfs (skippable via features)

spike_plan.kill_if: Curated subset cannot be made deterministic (flaky above about 5%) or lock and cache paths cannot be isolated from the network (K4). Or the hidden cases can only be graded by exact error text (K4).
spike_plan.pass_if: Build under 5 min offline; curated subset finishes under 10 min with identical per-test results over 3 runs; prototype hook runs and cache hit/miss is observable.
steps: Reuse the probe's cargo build at 2b50cbc0 (build_ok, 249 s). Confirm offline build from a clean cache in the throwaway container.

Install the Python interpreters the uv test suite needs into an absolute UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR, then run a curated subset (lock, sync, cache tests) with cargo nextest. Record per-test results and wall time.

Repeat the curated subset 3 times. Confirm per-test results match and that the subset finishes under 10 min. Find out why 2972 of 3074 tests failed in the probe (likely missing interpreters or git-lfs; confirm).
Write a throwaway 30-line prototype: read a [tool.uv.hooks] table in uv lock, run a project script with cwd set to the project, store a fingerprint file, and check cache hit and miss on a second run.
Check that a harness can assert lockfile contents, cache directory state and exit codes without matching free text. If it cannot, rewrite the grading surface before building.

v1.summary: The seed's source and licence check out: uv issue #14561 is open with no PR, the maintainer called plugins and dynamic metadata out of scope for now, and uv has no [tool.uv.hooks] table, so the shipped base should fail every graded case. Not killed, but the grading must avoid free-text snapshots (the sandbox and the 600 s probe timeout also need handling), and the 8h band and 3-5 day build cost are estimates the spike must confirm.

v2.note: The issue is real, but the maintainer called hooks out of scope and the [tool.uv.hooks] design is invented. The ~150 hidden cases would be hand-written against our own spec, so cache-fingerprint and lock semantics would penalise other valid designs (fails the 'accept any reasonable implementation' check). The probe suite is not deterministic (2972/3074 failing, three timeouts), so infrastructure failures would mix into the score. Realism is also weak: a maintainer would not accept this today.
